name: Cal-diy
description: Booking links for your calendar, the self-hosted edition of Cal.com

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The PostgreSQL database (users, event types, bookings, app keys) and state/secrets.env, this install's own keys made on first start. Back it up; stored calendar keys can't be read without the encryption key in it.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Cal.diy web app, booking pages and mail viewer (/mail), published on host as 6749

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6749. It must be the exact address you open Cal.diy at; sign-in, booking links and emails use it. Behind a domain, use that instead, like https://cal.example.com.
